import collections,hashlib,itertools,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
source=Path('/private/tmp/fq-application-gap-observations-20261122.json');p=json.loads(source.read_text());assert p['completed']
seeds=p['manifest']['compiler_seeds'];workflows=tuple(p['manifest']['configurations'])
expected={(f'{width:02d}/{family}/{topology}',seed,workflow) for width,family,topology,seed,workflow in itertools.product(WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,seeds,workflows)}
actual=collections.Counter((r['case'],r['seed'],r['workflow']) for r in p['rows']);assert set(actual)==expected and set(actual.values())=={1}
canonical=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
digest=lambda x:hashlib.sha256(canonical(x).encode()).hexdigest()
bundle=Bundle(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/docs/implementation'))
inputs={i['case']:i for i in p['inputs']};count=0;failures=[];maximum=0
for r in p['rows']:
 if 'payload_sha256' not in r:
  failures.append({'case':r['case'],'workflow':r['workflow'],'status':r['status']});continue
 n,family,topology=r['case'].split('/');width=int(n);f=fixture(width,family,topology,p['manifest']['input_nonce']);assert digest(f)==inputs[r['case']]['fixture_sha256']
 encoded=p['payloads'][r['payload_sha256']];assert hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode()).hexdigest()==r['payload_sha256']
 payload=json.loads(encoded);payload['compile_wall_seconds']=r['compile_wall_seconds']
 case=bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width==8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
 observed=routing(payload,f,None,case,0);assert observed==r['metrics'] and r['status']=='accepted'
 assert payload['final_layout']==list(range(width));count+=1;maximum=max(maximum,observed['max_semantic_error'])
 if count%100==0:print(json.dumps({'phase':'independent-replay','accepted':count}),flush=True)
assert not {'flagquantum','qiskit','cirq'}.intersection(sys.modules)
proof={'evidence_class':'development','source_commit':p['source_commit'],'observation_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'expected_rows':len(expected),'replayed':count,'failures_without_payload':failures,'max_semantic_error':maximum,'producer_sdks_imported':False,'full_operator_rows':sum(r.get('metrics',{}).get('verification')=='full-operator' for r in p['rows']),'three_probe_rows':sum(r.get('metrics',{}).get('verification')=='three-probes-only' for r in p['rows']),'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'script_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('/private/tmp/fq-application-gap-replay-proof-20261122.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in proof.items() if k!='script_source'}))
